title: Alert Troubleshooter
description: Bridges a HyperDX observability alert to an incident-agent root-cause analysis, written back as a TroubleshootingReport CR the portal renders.

global.title: Global values (injected by the Krateo composition engine)
global.description: Context keys the composition-dynamic-controller injects when this chart installs as a component (plumbing InjectGlobalValues), plus the helm-standard imageRegistry override.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Container image tag. Empty defaults to the chart appVersion (= the release tag), so chart and image move together.

autopilotA2aUrl.title: RCA agent A2A URL
autopilotA2aUrl.description: A2A endpoint of the agent the webhook calls for root-cause analysis. Defaults to the in-cluster kagent A2A Service `http://incident-agent.krateo-system.svc:8080/` (kagent names the Service after the Agent's metadata.name).

hyperdxApiUrl.title: HyperDX API URL
hyperdxApiUrl.description: HyperDX v2 external API the reconciler pushes Alert CRs to (Bearer auth). Defaults to the krateo-clickstack-api Service.

reportCooldown.title: Report cooldown (s)
reportCooldown.description: Dedup window in seconds: don't re-analyze the same alert within this.

reconcileInterval.title: Reconcile interval (s)
reconcileInterval.description: How often (seconds) the reconciler pushes Alert CRs to HyperDX.

defaultAlerts.title: Default alerts
defaultAlerts.description: Default Alert CRs the reconciler seeds into HyperDX (rendered to DEFAULT_ALERTS_JSON). Set to [] to seed none.
